candidate_contract: reject duplicate tool_call ids within one newly accepted assistant message before durable checkpoint/release
for restored/imported history, track unresolved multiplicity per id; a tool result resolves one outstanding occurrence, not every occurrence sharing the id
short continue remains blocked while any unresolved occurrence remains
reuse of an id after its prior occurrence was already resolved is not treated as concurrently ambiguous

current_behavior.findPendingToolCalls: uses Map keyed only by tool_call.id; every assistant call overwrites prior pending entry with same id; one tool result deletes the id entirely
current_behavior.reproduction: two unresolved assistant tool calls reuse call-1, then one tool result call-1; current pending count becomes 0
current_behavior.risk: a malformed/reused tool_call id can make an older unresolved mutating call disappear from restart/continue safety, allowing provider work when tool state is ambiguous
